_comment: Copy to gestures.json and edit. This file is the security boundary for
hermes_gesture.py: anyone standing in front of the Pi's camera can
trigger everything listed here, so keep it to things you would be
relaxed about a stranger doing. The defaults below are media keys, which
affect nothing but playback and cannot type into a focused window.
Keys are matched as '<HAND> <GESTURE>' first, then '<GESTURE>' alone.
Gestures are FIST OPEN POINT PEACE THUMB CALL ROCK PINCH -- and that
list is CLOSED. Any other hand shape fires nothing at all, which is why
moving your hand around no longer triggers a run of commands.
